credits.title: El Club del Pie Izquierdo
credits.overview: A forty-year-old office worker of Mexico City, realizes that he has been trapped in a car and a desk for years. He finds a dance academy, enrolls in reggaeton classes with strict teacher Paulina, and finds renewal. Remake of the Japanese film 'Shall We Dance?'

credits.title: Rock Bottom
credits.overview: Gungo is a scrawny, spoiled young caveman who has lived a life of luxury as the son of the tribal chief. In an age where only the strongest survive, he’d rather perform his “Tik-Rocks” dances than hunt or fight. credits.title: Welcome al Norte
credits.overview: Polito is a manager in a courier office in Izamal, Yucatan, and wants to fulfill his dream of a promotion and a job in Cancun to move with his wife Teo and son.
